assets.description: 纸偶小剧场，一株拟人棉花有低垂叶子和困惑的表情。前景下垂叶上有几只浅黄绿小椭圆蚜虫，枝头还没有白棉絮。小台边有一盆不同植物。不要画出版插画 Keep the drooping leaf and little aphids large enough to see. The same cotton girl appears in the healthy closing cell, before-and-after comparison.
棉花叶近景，小椭圆形的浅黄绿蚜虫成群聚在同一叶上，女孩形状的纸偶在旁低头 Make the clustered aphids readable as tiny pale green oval insects with tiny legs, on the leaf surface.
新舞台，燕子以叉尾飞来，低头棉花在下方相望，远背景很轻
黑白有小红冠的啄木鸟贴树干，一侧有木纹的剖开树干，小虫在树干里面，右下有棉花角色 The exposed wood tunnel and its tiny worm need to be visibly inside the wood; keep it separate from the leaf.
绿蛙向棉花姑娘跳来，后方分开可见稻苗与浅水，叶片不和稻苗重合 A distinct rice paddy with seedlings rising from shallow water must read at thumbnail size.

深绿棉花叶上圆形橙红小瓢虫与小浅黄绿蚜虫相对，俯侧视只显示看不全的背面，避免生成错数背点 Show a distinct orange-red ladybug on the same leaf as visible pale green aphids. Show the two kinds close together, in oblique side view. The ladybug back is partially occluded by its perspective, with no countable full arrangement of spots.
